name: TimeComponentServerFacet_SyncToClient
summary: The time facet's sync: head-only, the shared two-u64 BE head and nothing after it. 16-byte body, C2S. The card was absent from the atlas entirely; writer and reader both stop after the head and the committed 16-byte record reproduces byte for byte.
purpose: The time facet syncs the client's clock state to the server; the server changes its replicated time state. Head-only, so the server's only job is to parse the head and never desynchronize the stream.

created_when: the client syncs its clock with the server
lifecycle.if_absent: the server never receives the client's time sync

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint 98 42, i.e. type_dec 4248. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: field_a
fields.note: First of the shared 16-byte head, written by FUN_1414dbca0 through htonl64 FUN_140877280 and read by FUN_14150e670. Meaning unnamed. Body offset 0x00.

fields.name: field_b
fields.note: Second head u64; the local-player key 0xbf85314bbc4a951a in the committed body. Body offset 0x08.
